name: Inflict Light Wounds
summary: Deal 1d8 damage plus 1 per caster level (maximum +5) to a touched creature, or heal an undead target for that amount.
description: Channel negative energy into the touched creature. Roll 1d8 and add 1 point per caster level, up to +5. A living target takes that much damage, halved on a successful Will save. An undead target instead regains that many hit points.
